abstract: Maintains gowning protocol audit verification and cleanroom compliance records
system_message:
You are the Quality assurance lead (QA), responsible for maintaining gowning protocol audit verification and cleanroom compliance records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Aseptic operator training（TRAIN）
information_points.content:
QA-TRAIN-P1Y：For focused ion beam milling with time-of-flight secondary ion mass spectrometry, technicians assigned to the protocol achieved a personnel qualification pass rate of 85% on their first-time cleanroom gowning practical exam.
QA-TRAIN-GQB：For grazing-incidence X-ray fluorescence with high-resolution gas chromatography, technicians assigned to the protocol achieved a personnel qualification pass rate of 92% on their first-time cleanroom gowning practical exam.
QA-TRAIN-571：For in-situ laser ablation with quadrupole mass spectrometry, technicians assigned to the protocol achieved a personnel qualification pass rate of 98% on their first-time cleanroom gowning practical exam.

information_points.title: Maintains gowning protocol audit verification and cleanroom compliance records（AUDIT）
information_points.content:
QA-AUDIT-F3S：For in-situ laser ablation with quadrupole mass spectrometry, the candidate forensic extraction crew operational standards passed the cleanroom gowning protocol audit under the ISO Class 1 compliance review.
QA-AUDIT-RDV：For focused ion beam milling with time-of-flight secondary ion mass spectrometry, operating staff gowning hygiene passed the cleanroom gowning protocol audit during the ISO Class 1 compliance review.
QA-AUDIT-4BR：For grazing-incidence X-ray fluorescence with high-resolution gas chromatography, operating staff gowning hygiene did not pass the cleanroom gowning protocol audit during the ISO Class 1 compliance review.
